design: leakage-hardened re-confirmation of the funding-conditioned volatility + liquidation-risk hypothesis on the same on-disk ironflow bulk panel, applying ALL FCLR-POOLED-AUDIT-001 remediations simultaneously inside one pre-registered design
data: research_state/data_cache/ironflow_bulk/{candles_1h,funding,open_interest}, 18 months 2025-05..2026-10, .parquet.sha256 asserted before every read, caches read-only
context: FCLR-POOLED-001 (session_20261122T092003Z) returned NOT_SUPPORTED: funding-conditioned features add ~0.0% QLIKE vs RV-only baseline (rel ~0.0%, below -2.0% materiality floor; bootstrap CI95 includes zero). FCLR-POOLED-AUDIT-001 (session_20261122T165200Z) found concrete quality gaps that could have manufactured OR masked that null: d2 only a 1-hour train/test gap (48h purge+embargo NOT applied); d10 overlapping forward outcomes (pairwise Jaccard 0.52..0.92 dependence); d4 6.8% of rows above the 1% mark/index tolerance; d6/d7 delisting/survivorship (344 coins new, 44 exited, survivor share 38%); d9 monthly threshold drift. RESEARCH_PROMPT.md §10 priority 8 (adversarial audits) is done; §16/§19 require continuing after an unfavorable result instead of stopping; §9 still forbids any risk overlay because the forecast gate did not pass. This leakage-hardened re-confirmation is the highest-value unfinished task and is gate-enforced (FCLR-POOLED-ROBUST) so it cannot be skipped.

remediations_applied.d2_note: audit found only a 1h train/test gap; this design applies a real 48h purge+embargo on the chronological boundary (cut + 48h dropped before test).
remediations_applied.d10_note: audit found pairwise Jaccard 0.52..0.92 dependence across forward windows; this design makes forward-outcome windows non-overlapping by grouping test hours into contiguous 168h blocks and only admitting origins whose 24h forward window fits entirely inside one block.
remediations_applied.d4_note: audit found 6.8% of rows above the 1% mark-oracle premium tolerance; this design excludes those rows from the eligible test set.
remediations_applied.d6_note: delisting-aware per-coin identity: market->coin map built from candles; survivors = coins present in final 5% of hours; exited = seen but not survivor.
remediations_applied.d9_note: per-month funding-tercile thresholds computed on train only; drift (max/mean abs change in t2 across months) reported.

splits.boundary: cut between train_end and test_start; 48h purge+embargo dropped (audit gap 1h -> 48h)
splits.test: remaining distinct hourly timestamps AFTER the 48h purge+embargo, restricted to non-overlapping 168h-block origins with mark-oracle tolerance pass

primary_target: forward 24h realized variance (sum of squared 1h log returns over t+1..t+24h)
primary_metric: QLIKE(C2) - QLIKE(B1), reported as absolute difference and relative % reduction

models.B1: HAR-style OLS on log RV1h, log RV24h, log RV168h (training-only standardized), log(RV+1e-12) target, training-only smearing correction
models.C2: B1 + signed funding + premium index + open interest (training-only standardized)

secondary_target: Track B modeled boundary-breach proxy: breach if sqrt(forward 24h RV) > 2.5% band (20x leverage, 50% maintenance). LABELED MODELED, NEVER OBSERVED LIQUIDATION.
materiality_rule: materiality_met iff rel_pct <= -2.0 (C2 at least 2% better than B1)
uncertainty: per-coin block bootstrap, 2000 replicates, seed 20261122; resample coins with replacement, joint within coin; report CI95 of rel_pct
multiplicity: Holm across declared family {C2_vs_B1_primary, survivors_arm, exited_arm}; report raw and Holm-adjusted p; whole family disclosed

alpha_spending.rule: alpha_k = 0.05/(k*(k+1)) for k=2 => 0.05/6 = 0.008333; sequential confirmatory look k=2

decision_rule: SUPPORTED_LEAKAGE_ROBUST_EDGE iff materiality_met AND bootstrap CI95 upper bound < 0 AND Holm-adjusted primary p < alpha_2; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED_LEAKAGE_ROBUST_NULL (null confirmed leakage-robust). Either outcome is a valid, heavy, publishable result.
software: stdlib + pyarrow only; numpy/pandas/scipy not used; no network; no new source
input_sha256_note: Every parquet read asserts the on-disk .parquet.sha256 sidecar before use; full sha256 map is recorded in the robustness result JSON.
independent_recompute: fclr_pooled_robust002_recompute_20261122T190000Z.py (independent stdlib recompute from stored input hashes, no pyarrow, reproduces headline QLIKE within declared tolerance)
